title: Invoke chain kind: flow dir: down
call: A call to a Function | edge or inside funcd @gray
[Invoke chain] blue admit: Admit passes? | authn, health paths before: Before passes? | hold, rate, body, contract wake: Activator, worker | wake, call @gray after: After passes? | output contract ra: 401, 403 or 404 @red rb: 503, 429, 413 or 422 @red ok: Answer @gray rc: 500 | broken result @red [/]
call > admit admit > before: yes admit > ra: no before > wake: yes before > rb: no wake > after after > ok: yes after > rc: no
